title: 16th Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan

verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, (please) lead me so that I will correspond with the upright ones,
keep me away on this day from the company of the evils,

verses.arabic: وَاٰوِنِيْ فِيْهِ بِرَحْمَتِكَ اِلٰى دَارِ الْقَرَارِ،
verses.translation: and lodge me on this day, on account of Your mercy, to the Abode of Perpetual Settlement,
in the name of Your godhead, O God of the worlds!
